notes: Worked example: EUR 2.238,50 LEN subsidy+financing, EUR 2.761,50 paid at installation, LEF EUR 1.966,25 (5 x EUR 393,25). Structural adjustments not eligible. Net metering ends 2027-01-01 (see docs/tariffs_nl_2027.md).
Assessed case by case (maatwerk); no figures on the page.

name_en: Insulation (roof, wall, floor, glazing, interior wall)
target_group: owners of homes and businesses in Loenen
savings_claim: tot 30-50% op energieverbruik (insulation page); tot 50% op uw energierekening (homepage)
notes: Roof-from-inside example: EUR 21,00/m2 subsidy+financing and LEF EUR 17,00/m2 over 3 years; 70 m2 -> EUR 1.470 subsidy+financing, EUR 1.190 LEF, net EUR 280. Minimum Rd: cavity 1,7; roof and floor 3,5; interior wall 2,5; HR++ glass U < 1,2. Other per-m2 values sit behind calculators (not extracted). Needs buem envelope-retrofit variants.

notes: Example: RVO EUR 1.500, then LEN 37% of the remaining EUR 3.500 = EUR 1.295, customer pays EUR 2.205, LEF EUR 1.137,50 (5 x EUR 227,50), net EUR 157,50, payback 6-7 years. Testimonial: '6 stuks tot dusver' (undated). Ground-source variant: conversion_tech:heat_pump/geothermal/household.

The municipality's 2027 budget subsidy names hybridising homes (hybridiseren van woningen) as a sub-project of the gas-free(-ready) WUP (Gemeenteblad 2026-355914). This conflicts with the scenario's gas-free premise unless the gas is green gas. Needs a hybrid HP tech with a gas or green-gas input.

notes: Same example split as the heat pump (RVO EUR 1.500, LEN EUR 1.295, customer EUR 2.205). One system subsidised in 2019 (7 m2 collector, 750 l buffer).

notes: Wattflex: 25 households can get a home battery (own contribution, amount not stated). Also discussed at the end-of-net-metering evening (https://loenenenergie.nl/activiteit/bewonersavond-einde-salderingsregeling/). No stationary home battery tech exists in this package yet.

News item 'Naar een systeem van onderling energie-delen in Loenen?' (29 december 2025; article itself not read). Energy-sharing pilots are also named in the Apeldoorn 2027 budget subsidy. This is what the community optimisation step models (docs/energy_community_workflow.md).
Interreg 2023-2026, coordinated by TU Eindhoven. Pilots: dimmable collective rooftop PV and the central battery. Residents can sell flexibility or invest in the battery.

notes: Loenen is one of the first Wijken van de Toekomst in Apeldoorn; 'stap-voor-stap', no target year. Resident meeting 25 November 2025. Programme frame for this whole scenario rather than a single measure.

name_en: Green electricity and gas supply via OM
notes: ECL sells the Thomassen rooftop's output to supplier OM; OM customers are exempt from the ECL membership fee. No prices given.
ECL board decides; a budget is required.
Voting rights and access to member bonds. Exempt for OM energy customers. About 10% of Loenen's residents are members (Gemeenteblad 2026-355914).
